description: This file defines the main home component and related hooks for a React-based web application, incorporating dynamic imports, routing, theme management, localization, and data loading logic.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A React component that displays a loading indicator, optionally without a logo.

methods.name: useSwitchTheme
methods.description: A hook that manages theme switching, updating body classes and meta tags based on user preferences.

methods.name: useHtmlLang
methods.description: A hook that sets the HTML document's language attribute based on the user's locale.

methods.name: useHasHydrated
methods.description: A hook that determines if the React app has been hydrated on the client-side.

methods.name: loadAsyncGoogleFont
methods.description: Loads Google Fonts asynchronously by appending a stylesheet link element to the document head.

methods.name: Screen
methods.description: Main component handling routing, layout, and conditional rendering based on route path.

methods.name: useLoadData
methods.description: Loads model data from the API based on current configuration.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Top-level component that initializes theme, data, localization, and renders the main router within error boundary.
